seo.title: Camera Icon project
seo.description: Small-format render study focused on silhouette, rim light, and readable product-style presentation.

caseStudy.hook: A compact study in making a simple object feel precise.
brief: The challenge was to preserve clarity at small sizes while keeping the full-frame render from feeling sterile.

sections.title: Readability first
body: Silhouette, rim light, and tonal grouping do most of the work here.
The piece is intentionally minimal so the lighting choices stay obvious.

outcomes: A tighter reference for product-style icon framing
